items.q: How do I register for a class?
items.a: Create a free account with your mobile number, then open the Store in your dashboard, choose your class and month, and upload your bank slip.

items.q: How do I pay the class fee?
items.a: Pay by bank deposit or online transfer to the account shown in the Store. Use your Student ID as the reference and upload a photo of the slip.

items.q: When will I get access after paying?
items.a: Your payment is checked manually. Once approved, the class month unlocks automatically, usually within a few hours.

items.q: Can I watch the recordings again?
items.a: Yes. Recordings for every month you have paid for stay available in My Classes, organised week by week.

items.q: When can I join a live class?
items.a: The Join button appears 20 minutes before the class starts. The link is shown only to students who have paid for that month.

items.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
items.a: Contact us on WhatsApp with your Student ID and registered mobile number and we will reset it for you.

about.label: About the program
about.p1: An A/L Combined Mathematics programme led by Hasitha Madusanka, Combined Maths lecturer on the national TV programme Guruthalawa and the Jathika Pasala YouTube channel.
about.p2: Through Theory, Revision and Paper classes we cover the full syllabus from start to finish and walk you step by step to the doors of the engineering faculty.

process.label: How we work
process.title: Our Process
process.subtitle: From the first lesson to the exam hall, every step is planned.

items.title: Theory Classes
items.text: Every Pure and Applied concept from the ground up, with worked examples and short-cuts for a solid foundation.

items.title: Revision Classes
items.text: The whole syllabus revisited in a short time, building speed and confidence in problem solving.

items.title: Paper Classes
items.text: Weekly timed papers, marking and full discussion, real exam experience before the exam.

items.title: Online Classes
items.text: Join live from anywhere in the island. Missed a lesson? Watch the HD recording any time.

items.title: Tute Delivery
items.text: Lesson-matched tutes and papers delivered island-wide to your door.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.title: About Your Teacher
teacher.text: A Combined Maths lecturer on the national TV programme Guruthalawa and the Jathika Pasala YouTube channel, Hasitha sir has reached thousands of students across the island and turns Combined Maths from a subject you fear into one you love. Through his ‘staircase that builds engineers’, students step into universities and engineering faculties every year.
